 Matt Olson wins 2026 Silver Slugger Award
 Olson joins some exclusive company in Braves history when it comes to winning both the Silver Slugger and the Gold Glove
 by Demetrius Bell Nov 17, 2026, 11:34 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 This has certainly been a busy Awards Season for Matt Olson. He took home a Fielding Bible Award to start things off, he then earned the Gold Glove Award for the fourth time in his career shortly after that and now, he can add “Multi-Time Silver Slugger Award Winner” to what is becoming a very impressive career resume.
 MLB and Louisville Slugger announced their annual Silver Slugger Award winners on Tuesday night and Olson joined some rarefied air in picking up his second career Silver Slugger Award and his first since 2023.
 As this press release from the Braves mentions, Olson has joined some elite (and exclusive) company when it comes to winning both the Gold Glove and the Silver Slugger in the same season.
 The Atlanta native is only the second Braves’ first baseman to win multiple Silver Slugger Awards, and one of three to take home the award since it was first bestowed in 1980, joining Freddie Freeman (2019-‘21) and Fred McGriff (1993).
 Olson was also awarded a Rawlings Gold Glove award for defensive excellence following the season, and is just the seventh player in Atlanta franchise history to win both awards in the same year. He is the only infielder to do so, joining outfielders Dale Murphy (1982-1985), Andruw Jones (2005) and Nick Markakis (2018), and pitchers Mike Hampton (2003) and Max Fried (2021).
 Yeah, that’s pretty impressive. Olson earned this award while hitting .251/.321/.502 for the season with a wOBA of .351, a 122 wRC+ and 41 home runs. In terms of overall production, he actually took a slight step back when compared to what he did in 2025 and to be honest with y’all, he probably had a better argument for winning the award last season rather than this past season. With that being said, I’ve never been one to block a blessing and I’d imagine that Matt Olson is the same in that regard so I’m sure he’s very happy to accept this award in order to cap of what’s been a very impressive season in terms of accolades.
 So, to sum up Awards Season for the Braves, we have:
 Fielding Bible Award for Matt Olson 
 Gold Gloves for Matt Olson and Mauricio Dubón 
 All-MLB First Team for Chris Sale 
 Silver Slugger for Matt Olson 
 This Matt Olson fella is pretty good, right?
